## About
The Oil Exchange on Outer Dr W is one of The Oil Exchange's metro Detroit locations, and it's a neighborhood stop for drivers in west Dearborn who want their oil changed right without a long wait.
Every full service oil exchange covers more than the oil. The crew checks your fluids, wiper blades, lights, air and cabin filters and belts, and cleans your windows before you go. Beyond that, they offer flushes, tire rotation, AC recharge and mechanic work on everything from shocks to transmissions.
We're rated 4.6 from 435 Google reviews, and we're open every day of the week. Call or stop by anytime.

## Services
- Full service oil exchange: Oil and oil filter change, plus checks on washer, brake, power steering, transmission, coolant and differential fluids, tire pressure, wiper blades, lights, air and cabin filters, belts and more. Windows cleaned too.
- Tire rotation and engine flush: Tire rotation, fuel injection cleaner and engine and power steering flushes, along with transmission, radiator, differential and transfer case flushes, a transmission filter and AC recharge.
- Mechanic work: Tune-ups, shocks, mufflers, brakes, tires, alignment, transmission and engine work, front end to rear end. Call or visit for an estimate.
- Fleet service: National fleet accounts are accepted, including ARI, DONLIEN, WHEELS, PHH, GE and UNION LEASING.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: Yes. Sunday hours are 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

Q: Can I get an estimate for repair work?
A: Yes. Call or stop by for an estimate on any mechanic work, from brakes and shocks to transmission and engine jobs.

Q: What oil brands do you carry?
A: Mobil, Quaker State, Motorcraft and Valvoline, along with foreign oil filters, air filters, cabin filters and wiper blades.

Q: Do you take credit cards?
A: Yes, all major credit cards are accepted.
